hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if [ -z "$f" ]; then exit 0; fi; base=$(basename "$f"); if [[ "$base" == .env* && "$base" != ".env.example" ]]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: only .env.example may be read or edited; other .env* files can contain secrets."}}'; fi; }
